text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...You are well aware, aren't you, Gold 
Ship-san? Today is my birthday. Which 
means—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The domino toppling tournament, right? I'm 
fired up... 'Cause you and me are gonna 
smash that world record together...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You are m-i-s-t-a-k-e-n! You promised you 
would attend my birthday party at the 
Mejiro estate, remember?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, go prepare your dress at once!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh, no way, that's such a pain. Instead 
of that, let's all bake a cake together! 
One decorated with 256 colors!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Grandmother of the Mejiro family will 
also be attending the party."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I speak of you often to my grandmother. As 
classmates who push each other to excel... 
and also—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are a precious friend whom I 
hold in fond regard. ...That is also how I 
plan to introduce you on the day, is that 
fine?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, between a princess line dress 
and a mermaid line dress, which one do you 
think is closer to golden?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to emphasize elegance, the 
latter would be preferable. However, I 
believe a simple A-line silhouette would 
suit you splendidly as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Geez, changing your mind out of nowhere 
like that. You really are hopeless.
